title: Official Woolworth Building Tour with Exclusive Access
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the iconic Woolworth Building on this officially authorized tour, offering exclusive access to its grand lobby and hidden vault. This 90-minute experience reveals the architectural marvel's history, from its stunning neo-Gothic design to its significance as a commercial landmark. With licensed NYC guides, delve into the building's past and uncover fascinating stories about its construction and role in Lower Manhattan's development. Perfect for architecture enthusiasts and history buffs alike, this tour provides a unique glimpse into one of New York City's architectural treasures.

Duration: Approximately 90 minutes with guided access to lobby and vault
Discover the grand lobby with its 60-foot vaulted ceiling and mosaic details
Visit the original vault featuring surviving safe-deposit boxes
Expert guides share insider knowledge about the building's history and context
